_comment: Spells of the Player's Handbook (2024), PDF pages 242-346. Names, pages and classification only.

entries.name: Alarm
entries.note: a ward round the camp for 8 hours: whatever comes near in the night wakes the party, and nobody takes the animals unseen; a single door or window is not warded on its own, and the mental ping is the same as the bell

entries.name: Alter Self
entries.note: on the road Change Appearance is a disguise no watchman sees through (for the hour); in a fight Aquatic Adaptation's swim speed; Natural Weapons are left out

entries.name: Animal Messenger
entries.note: a bird carries the words 50 miles a day to a companion waiting within 50 miles, who then sets out; cast as a ritual on the road it gains nothing from higher slots

entries.name: Antilife Shell
entries.note: an aura on the caster whose gift is disadvantage on attacks by every kind but undead and constructs, for friends within 10 feet; the barrier that stops them passing or reaching through, and the spell ending when the caster forces someone through it, are left out

entries.name: Antimagic Field
entries.note: spells already on creatures in the aura go on working, and area spells may still catch those inside; the aura stops casting, scrolls, summons and spell-made things from reaching in, but not magic items' properties, teleporting or portals

entries.name: Antipathy/Sympathy
entries.note: cast on the caster (an hour; 10 days): a kind of creature that roams the land here is named; a band of that kind met on the road makes Wisdom saves: Antipathy turns it away if most of it fails (some shy off otherwise), Sympathy brings the failed ones entranced (the party sees them first); the 120-foot zone and the saves on leaving it are folded into the meeting

entries.name: Arcane Eye
entries.note: the eye's hour of flight is the whole level it can reach (never through a secret door) mapped at once, its bands marked; steering it is left out

entries.name: Arcane Gate
entries.note: under the ground only: a gate from where you stand to the stairs up or down within 500 feet; the portals' facing and their use in a fight are left out

entries.name: Arcane Vigor
entries.note: 2d6 + the casting modifier (1d6 more a slot) stands in for spending Hit Point Dice

entries.name: Astral Projection
entries.note: until the planes come, the party's spirits cross the Astral and draw their bodies to any known town (a jacinth and four 25 GP silver bars each); the silver cord and the astral forms wait for Expansion 26

entries.name: Augury
entries.note: weal, woe, both or neither for going further down, the road ahead or a work in hand, read from what truly waits (the level's strength, the bottom's hoard, a work's hidden side); the 25% a casting again before a long rest

entries.name: Aura of Life
entries.note: the guard on hit point maximums is left out

entries.name: Aura of Vitality
entries.note: the healing after the first costs a bonus action each turn (the book gives it free at the start of your turn), and reaches one friend within 30 feet of you

entries.name: Awaken
entries.note: eight hours and a 1,000 GP stone (an agate in the book) on one of the party's animals: it speaks and keeps watch (the camp is never caught asleep, rustlers are called out); the 30 days of charm then friendship are moot for a beast already yours; awakening a plant waits for Part F's followers

entries.name: Beacon of Hope
entries.note: up to six friends within 30 feet, not any number

entries.name: Beast Sense
entries.note: through one of the party's animals for an hour: a band on the road is seen before it sees you; its special senses are left out

entries.name: Befuddlement
entries.note: the mind stays blasted for the rest of the fight, not until a save every 30 days; Greater Restoration, Heal and Wish do not end it

entries.name: Bestow Curse
entries.note: only the extra 1d8 necrotic option is in the game; the three other curses and the longer durations from higher slots are left out

entries.name: Bigby's Hand
entries.note: only the Clenched Fist (5d8 force, a bonus action each turn moves it 20 feet and strikes); Forceful, Grasping and Interposing Hand, the hand's AC and hit points, and its 60-foot move are left out; it is the spiritual-weapon token, so a caster has one or the other

entries.name: Blade Barrier
entries.note: the wall is a straight line 100 feet long laid from the caster's side (the book: range 90 feet, or a ringed wall); the three-quarters cover it gives is left out; a creature saves once per turn

entries.name: Blight
entries.note: a Plant creature failing the save automatically and withering a plain plant are left out

entries.name: Blindness/Deafness
entries.note: only Blindness

entries.name: Call Lightning
entries.note: the extra 1d10 when cast under a storm and the cloud's own position are left out; each later bolt takes an action, as the book's Magic action

entries.name: Calm Emotions
entries.note: hostile humanoids who fail stand down, incapacitated until hurt; the end of charm and fear is left out

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.note: a bolt at one foe, then leaps to three more within 30 feet of it, nearest first, one more per slot above 6; objects as targets are not in the game

entries.name: Chromatic Orb
entries.note: the leap on matching dice is left out; the type is the one the target is weakest to

entries.name: Circle of Death
entries.note: 8d8 necrotic in a 60-foot radius, Constitution save for half, 2d8 per slot above 6; hurts friends in it too

entries.name: Clairvoyance
entries.note: under the ground: the two nearest rooms not yet seen are seen with who is in them (sight only; hearing, the switch and places on the road left out)

entries.name: Cloud of Daggers
entries.note: moved by its follow-up anywhere within 60 feet of the caster

entries.name: Cloudkill
entries.note: the cloud stays where it is laid; its drift of 10 feet away from the caster each turn is left out; the book's wind-dispersal is not modelled

entries.name: Command
entries.note: adapted: always Grovel; the other four words come with choices in battle (Part C)

entries.name: Commune
entries.note: three yes-or-no questions from those the world can answer (a work as told, a lost artifact where it lies, a dragon alive, a beast in its lair, a companion well): the one chosen and the two weightiest; the 25% a casting again

entries.name: Commune with Nature
entries.note: outdoors, the land within 3 miles: places (towns and sites go on the map), water, the commonest game and plant (+5 to hunt and forage), the strongest creature near (a dragon or a beast of the songs; portals wait for the planes, Expansion 26); in a cave the passages within 300 feet and the worst band in them; not in a town or built halls

entries.name: Compelled Duel
entries.note: only the disadvantage against others; the 30-foot leash and its endings are left out

entries.name: Comprehend Languages
entries.note: an hour: a band sharing no tongue with the party can be talked past at +5 to the DC; reading written tongues waits for writing in other languages

entries.name: Compulsion
entries.note: the foes in 30 feet of the caster all save at once, and those failing run straight away from the caster with their reaction (no direction chosen, no bonus action to redirect), saving again at the end of each turn

entries.name: Confusion
entries.note: the sphere growing 5 feet for each higher slot is left out

entries.name: Conjure Animals
entries.note: moving the pack takes a bonus action (the book moves it with your move); the pack is a fixed 10-foot radius that hurts whoever is caught, enters or ends a turn there; the advantage on Strength saves near it and the chosen animal form are left out

entries.name: Conjure Celestial
entries.note: the pillar is a zone: friends in it are healed 4d12 plus the casting modifier and foes save for 6d12 radiant (half on a save), once a turn each, at once and whenever someone enters or ends a turn there; it is moved with a bonus action, not as the caster moves; the choice of light for each creature is made by who they are (friend or foe); the 40-foot height and the bright light are not counted

entries.name: Conjure Elemental
entries.note: the spirit is always of fire; it is a 20-foot patch of ground that holds, not a creature

entries.name: Conjure Fey
entries.note: a spirit that strikes at once and with a bonus action on later turns (it is moved by the usual spirit-weapon rules, not a teleport of exactly 30 feet), 3d12 psychic plus the spellcasting modifier and frightened until the caster's next turn

entries.name: Conjure Minor Elementals
entries.note: the extra damage is fire only (no choice of acid, cold or lightning), applies to every attack rather than only to creatures within 15 feet, and the difficult terrain around the caster is left out

entries.name: Conjure Woodland Beings
entries.note: the free Disengage as a bonus action is left out

entries.name: Contact Other Plane
entries.note: the DC 15 Intelligence save; on a failure 6d6 psychic and Incapacitated until a long rest (no casting, incapacitated in a fight; Greater Restoration ending it waits for its spell on the road); five of the world's questions, one in six unclear

entries.name: Contagion
entries.note: 11d8 necrotic and poisoned on a failed Constitution save, a save at each turn's end ends it on the first success (the book wants three successes or failures, and seven days if it takes hold); the chosen ability's disadvantage on saves and the protection against cures are left out

entries.name: Continual Flame
entries.note: the flame is on a torch from the packs (or a stick), which becomes an everburning torch: carried, it lights the way for ever; it cannot be dispelled yet

entries.name: Cordon of Arrows
entries.note: four arrows become a store of 20 piercing harm (a guardian); more arrows by slot and the creatures it spares are left out

entries.name: Counterspell
entries.note: a reaction for the party and for creatures whose spells name it

entries.name: Create Food and Water
entries.note: fifteen days' conjured food that spoils in a day, and thirty gallons poured into the party's skins (the thirsty drink first, the rest soaks away); steeds are not fed by it

entries.name: Create or Destroy Water
entries.note: Create Water: ten gallons (ten more a slot level) into the party's skins, the thirsty drinking first; the rain that puts out flames and Destroy Water wait for fog and fire outside a fight

entries.name: Crown of Madness
entries.note: the Magic action to keep control is left out; its blow is at the foe's own friend in reach, the one hurt worst

entries.name: Dancing Lights
entries.note: the four lights light one patch of the field (a 10-foot sphere, dim); they are not moved with a bonus action and do not take a humanlike form

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.note: 150 feet for 8 hours, outside a fight (dungeons, the night) and in one

entries.name: Daylight
entries.note: the sunlight is carried by the caster (60 feet bright, 60 dim), not set at a point; it ends magical Darkness of level 3 or lower that it touches; sunlight sensitivity is not yet read by creatures

entries.name: Delayed Blast Fireball
entries.note: 12d6 fire in a 20-foot sphere, Dexterity save for half, up 1d6 a slot; the bead bursts at once, so the growing damage each turn, the concentration, throwing it back and touching it are left out; dry ground catches fire

entries.name: Destructive Wave
entries.note: 30-foot emanation round the caster, enemies only; 5d6 thunder and 5d6 radiant, half on a save, prone on a fail; necrotic as the alternative to radiant is left out

entries.name: Detect Evil and Good
entries.note: cast outside a fight: the bands of those six kinds within 30 feet not behind stone are marked for ten minutes; Hallow waits for its spell (E.4), haunted battlefields and barrows are told instead

entries.name: Detect Magic
entries.note: cast outside a fight only: the auras of unknown things in the packs with their school, and closed chests or things on the ground within 30 feet that hold magic (a chest's contents are settled once sensed), stopped by stone; the school of a spell's lingering effect and use in a fight are left out

entries.name: Detect Poison and Disease
entries.note: outside a fight: the party's diseases (even those not yet showing), food and water gone foul, poisoned darts and venomous bands within 30 feet; use in a fight left out

entries.name: Detect Thoughts
entries.note: in a fight, Sense Thoughts: thinking creatures within 30 feet (a person, or one with a language) are known where they are, invisible or hidden, unless total cover stands between; outside one, Read Thoughts on a townsman near you (Wisdom save): their feeling, want and secret, and a work's hidden side; the deeper probe's turn and the Arcana check to end it are left out

entries.name: Dimension Door
entries.note: taking a willing creature along, and the 4d6 force when the arrival space is taken, are left out

entries.name: Disguise Self
entries.note: an hour outside a fight: a disguise whose quality is the caster's spell save DC (a watchman's check against it sees through, as the book's Investigation check); touching through it is left out

entries.name: Disintegrate
entries.note: creatures only: 10d6+40 force on a failed Dexterity save, dust at 0 hit points; the automatic disintegration of objects and walls of force is left out

entries.name: Dispel Evil and Good
entries.note: the ward (disadvantage on attacks against the caster by celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead) and the Dismissal as an action follow-up (Charisma save, sent away until concentration ends); Break Enchantment is left out, and using Dismissal does not end the ward as the book says

entries.name: Dissonant Whispers
entries.note: the frightened foe is driven straight away, without opportunity attacks

entries.name: Divination
entries.note: one question about a work in hand: its hidden side told truly and where its place, person or beast is; questions about anything else are left out; the 25% a casting again

entries.name: Divine Smite
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute)

entries.name: Divine Word
entries.note: a bonus action; enemies within 30 feet save with Charisma; a failure sends celestials, elementals, fey and fiends away for good and acts on the rest by hit points (20 or fewer dies, 21-30 blinded, deafened and stunned for an hour, 31-40 blinded and deafened for ten minutes, 41-50 deafened for a minute); the 24-hour bar is for good here; the caster chooses no creatures to spare (friends are not touched)

entries.name: Dominate Beast
entries.note: the telepathic commands and the reaction command are left out (the beast fights on the caster's side); the longer durations from higher slots are left out

entries.name: Dominate Monster
entries.note: the telepathic link, commands and the reaction order are left out (the held creature fights for the caster's side); the higher-slot duration is left out

entries.name: Dominate Person
entries.note: a humanoid fails a Wisdom save (advantage while fought) and fights on the caster's side, saving again each time it is hurt; the telepathic orders are not given, and the longer duration with higher slots is left out

entries.name: Dragon's Breath
entries.note: on the caster only (not a touched friend); the type is the one the foes are weakest to

entries.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
entries.note: a carried thing of 10 pounds or less bound to a sapphire (crushed from the pack by the one who bound it); what robbers or the watch take is kept in a sack or a strongbox, not in hand, so it comes back; a thing sold or given away does not come, and who holds it is not told

entries.name: Dream
entries.note: a companion far away is told to come; or a nightmare for a named beast or dragon of the world (its Wisdom save): 3d6 and no rest, so it meets the party hurt within a day; shaping the dream left out

entries.name: Druidcraft
entries.note: the weather here for the next 24 hours, in words, from the world's own weather (so it comes true), and the camp's fire lit or put out; blooming flowers and the small sensory tricks are words only

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.note: it spares the caster's side, as if cast from afar; the save comes as creatures enter or start a turn there rather than at the end of the caster's turns; fissures and the 50 damage to structures are left out

entries.name: Elemental Weapon
entries.note: only fire is offered (not acid, cold, lightning or thunder), and the weapon is not checked to be nonmagical

entries.name: Elementalism
entries.note: outside a fight: beckon fire lights the camp's fire, beckon air dries the party a little, beckon water fills a cup of clean water for each who is thirsty; sculpting an element is left out

entries.name: Enhance Ability
entries.note: the target's best ability is chosen; Advantage is given as +5 to its checks (the 2024 rule for a passive score, used for every check here)

entries.name: Enlarge/Reduce
entries.note: only Reduce, on a foe: less damage and weakness in Strength; Enlarge waits

entries.name: Ensnaring Strike
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute); the Large creature's advantage and the Athletics check to break free are left out

entries.name: Entangle
entries.note: the plants catch everyone in the area, the caster's side too (as Web)

entries.name: Enthrall
entries.note: in a town: everyone within 60 feet who fails a Wisdom save has -10 to Perception for the minute: they are no witnesses, a merchant watches your hands at -10, creeping past them is easier; foes in a fight are not offered it (they would succeed)

entries.name: Etherealness
entries.note: outside a fight: nothing on the road meets the party, walls and doors do not stop it under the ground, traps do not spring, chests cannot be touched; back inside stone, it is shunted out with force damage; the Ethereal Plane itself waits for Expansion 26

entries.name: Expeditious Retreat
entries.note: the Dash as it is cast is left out; later turns may Dash as a bonus action

entries.name: Eyebite
entries.note: always the Asleep effect (unconscious until hurt); Panicked and Sickened are left out, and a creature that saved is not barred from being targeted again by the follow-up action

entries.name: Faerie Fire
entries.note: only the advantage against the outlined; the light and the end of invisibility are left out

entries.name: Fear
entries.note: the frightened run with their reaction rather than Dashing every turn, and dropping what they hold is left out; a frightened foe still cannot come closer to you

entries.name: Feather Fall
entries.note: cast by itself with the reaction when someone falls within 60 feet (a fight's fall, a dungeon's pit): no harm from the fall; one faller a casting

entries.name: Feign Death
entries.note: in a fight: a willing friend lies as if dead (blinded, incapacitated, resisting all damage but psychic, immune to poison); no foe aims at them, and if the fight is lost the foes take everyone for dead and go

entries.name: Find the Path
entries.note: for a day nobody loses the way, and under the ground the way to the stairs down (up from the deepest) is shown on the map; naming a far place and its distance are left out

entries.name: Find Traps
entries.note: every trap within 120 feet in sight is sensed by its nature, not its place; the party searches for a sensed trap and saves against it with Advantage (the game's reading of knowing it is there)

entries.name: Finger of Death
entries.note: 7d8+30 necrotic, Constitution save for half, as the book says; the zombie that rises from a slain humanoid waits for Part F

entries.name: Fire Shield
entries.note: only the warm shield (resist cold, 2d8 fire back) is in; the chill shield and the light it sheds are left out

entries.name: Fire Storm
entries.note: 7d10 fire, Dexterity save for half, enemies only; the ten 10-foot cubes the caster arranges are one 30-foot block (the caster arranges them round friends: here friends are simply spared); dry ground catches fire

entries.name: Flaming Sphere
entries.note: moved by its follow-up anywhere within 60 feet; it harms those who enter or start a turn by it, does not stop on a creature or light fires

entries.name: Flesh to Stone
entries.note: restrained, three saves of a kind at each turn's end (three successes free it, three failures petrify it) and a rooted foe on a save, as the book says; the permanent stone after a full minute of concentration is left out

entries.name: Fog Cloud
entries.note: the larger radius of a higher slot is left out

entries.name: Forcecage
entries.note: only the solid box of 10 feet: everyone in it is sealed away until concentration ends (up to an hour; a caster whose only foes left are sealed lets them go at the start of its turn), and Dispel Magic cannot end it; the cage of bars (20 feet), the Charisma save to teleport out, and creatures too big or only partly inside being pushed out are left out; consumes ruby dust

entries.name: Foresight
entries.note: touch a willing creature (the caster included): Advantage on its attack rolls, saves and checks and Disadvantage on attacks against it, eight hours; recasting to end it early is not needed

entries.name: Fount of Moonlight
entries.note: the reaction that blinds whoever hurt the caster is left out

entries.name: Freedom of Movement
entries.note: immunity to paralysis and restraint is in; magic not reducing Speed, the Swim Speed and the free escape from nonmagical bonds are left out

entries.name: Friends
entries.note: outside a fight on a person within 10 feet (Wisdom save; not twice in 24 hours): Friendly for the talk that follows (a conversation takes no time here, so the minute is the talk's ten minutes of the world); when it ends they know, and like you 20 less; ending early on an attack or a save forced is moot in a talk

entries.name: Gaseous Form
entries.note: in a fight only: a mist that flies 10 feet, resists blows and blades, has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, cannot fall prone, attack or cast; passing through cracks (a locked door, a cell's bars) is left out

entries.name: Gate
entries.note: until the planes come, a portal to any known town in this world; calling a creature by its true name is left out

entries.name: Geas
entries.note: on a person near you (Wisdom save): 30 days, 365 from a 7th or 8th-level slot, until ended from a 9th; the command is the game's: keep silent about the crimes of yours they saw and witness none of the new ones, tell what they want and hide, stay Friendly; a guard never arrests you; they obey, so the 5d10 psychic for defying it never comes; when it ends they know (-40)

entries.name: Gentle Repose
entries.note: on a fallen companion the party carries: its ten days do not count against a spell of return and the body is not buried meanwhile; the two copper pieces are left out (a focus serves); the guard against becoming undead waits for Animate Dead (Part F)

entries.name: Glibness
entries.note: an hour: every Charisma check's d20 counts as 15 at least (talk, haggling with the Influence check, bribing the watch, a disguise kit); no magic in the game tests the truth of the player's words, so its second clause has nothing to answer

entries.name: Globe of Invulnerability
entries.note: the barrier is an aura that moves with the caster (the book's is immobile); spells of the slot's level or lower are kept out, one more level for each slot above 6

entries.name: Goodberry
entries.note: ten berries in the pack, each a day's food and a hit point when eaten, gone a day after they were made; eating one is part of eating on the road, not a bonus action in a fight

entries.name: Grasping Vine
entries.note: the vine is at the caster (a foe up to 60 feet away is pulled up to 50 feet towards the caster); the escape DC is the holder's unarmed DC, not the spell save DC; more grapples from higher slots are left out

entries.name: Greater Restoration
entries.note: ends petrification, or else a charm; the cures for exhaustion, curses, drained ability scores and reduced hit point maximum are left out (not battle effects); consumes diamond dust

entries.name: Guidance
entries.note: adapted: adds 1d4 to ability checks with every skill, not one chosen skill

entries.name: Gust of Wind
entries.note: a single push on a failed save along a 5-foot line; the lasting wind is left out

entries.name: Hail of Thorns
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute)

entries.name: Hallucinatory Terrain
entries.note: a ward on the camp for 24 hours: hunters and night visitors pass it by unless the cleverest of a band beats the DC with an Intelligence (Investigation) check; any rest may be taken with enemies hunting near

entries.name: Harm
entries.note: 14d6 necrotic and the hit point maximum cut by the damage taken as the book says, but the maximum comes back after the fight

entries.name: Haste
entries.note: the extra action is one more attack with the Attack action, not also Dash, Disengage, Hide or Utilize

entries.name: Heal
entries.note: 70 hit points (10 more per slot above 6) and the blinded, deafened and poisoned conditions end

entries.name: Heat Metal
entries.note: works on any foe (no metal check); a failed save leaves its next attack at a disadvantage

entries.name: Heroes' Feast
entries.note: the feast also feeds and waters those who eat it

entries.name: Hex
entries.note: the disadvantage on one ability's checks and moving it to a new creature are left out

entries.name: Hold Monster
entries.note: adapted: with a higher slot the extra targets are the nearest others in range

entries.name: Hold Person
entries.note: adapted: with a higher slot the extra targets are the nearest others in range

entries.name: Holy Aura
entries.note: the aura follows the caster and grants friends in it advantage on every save; the choice of which creatures it covers is every friend in the aura

entries.name: Hunger of Hadar
entries.note: the acid is dealt when someone enters or starts a turn there (the book: at the end of the turn), and the Blinded condition inside is shown as heavy darkness; the cold is dealt on entering or at the start of the turn

entries.name: Hunter's Mark
entries.note: the Perception and Survival advantage and moving the mark are left out

entries.name: Hypnotic Pattern
entries.note: the charmed are incapacitated until hurt, but their Speed is not set to 0, and a friend shaking them awake with an action is left out

entries.name: Identify
entries.note: adapted: outside a fight only; no ritual casting yet (Expansion 3)

entries.name: Illusory Script
entries.note: a letter (lead ink spent) that for 10 days shows each reader the seal they would honour: the gate's wardens wave you through unsearched, and your papers impress everyone as a lord's signet does (+5); Truesight and secret messages for chosen readers are left out

entries.name: Incendiary Cloud
entries.note: the cloud does not drift 10 feet away each turn, and a strong wind does not disperse it

entries.name: Jallarzi's Storm of Radiance
entries.note: two overlapping ground effects (2d10 radiant, 2d10 thunder), so each damage kind has its own Constitution save; a failed radiant save blinds until the turn's end where the book blinds and deafens everyone inside as long as they stay, and stops verbal spells

entries.name: Jump
entries.note: a leap of 30 feet standing or running, as often as the creature leaps (the book: once a turn, for 10 feet of movement)

entries.name: Legend Lore
entries.note: a storied or unknown thing carried is identified with its curse and story; a lost artifact's resting place, a beast of the songs' lair, kills and weakness, a site's depth and master; the incense is used up and the four ivory strips kept

entries.name: Leomund's Tiny Hut
entries.note: a dome over the camp for 8 hours: the night's visitors cannot get in and go away, and inside it is dry and warm whatever the weather; it ends when the party leaves the camp; not in the middle of a town; spells through it and its light are left out

entries.name: Lesser Restoration
entries.note: adapted: also eases a disease taking hold, since the game's diseases have no other magical cure before Expansion 3

entries.name: Levitate
entries.note: aimed at a foe (Constitution save): it rises 20 feet and hangs out of reach, floating down gently when the spell ends; changing its height and raising a friend or an object are left out

entries.name: Light
entries.note: the light is carried by the caster (something they hold), not set on any object touched; it lights a dungeon and the close view at night, and in a fight it shines round the caster; its colour is not chosen

entries.name: Lightning Arrow
entries.note: the lightning is added to the weapon's own damage rather than replacing it, nothing happens on a miss (the book: half damage), and the target also saves against the 2d8 burst

entries.name: Locate Animals or Plants
entries.note: game or herbs: the next hunt or forage here has +5 for twelve hours; a beast a work hunts is found within 5 miles; other kinds left out

entries.name: Locate Creature
entries.note: on a close-up map: a captive, a named master of the place, someone met in this town or a work's person, within 1,000 feet, marked (it follows them) for the hour; a kind of creature is left out

entries.name: Locate Object
entries.note: on a close-up map: a chest on the level, the hoard, a work's lost thing or a lost artifact's chest within 1,000 feet, marked for ten minutes; naming any other kind of object is left out

entries.name: Longstrider
entries.note: +10 feet of speed for an hour, one more creature for each slot above 1; on the road it makes up for a load or a lame leg (the 2024 travel pace does not grow with speed)

entries.name: Mage Armor
entries.note: adapted: cast on yourself only

entries.name: Magic Mouth
entries.note: a ward on the camp (jade dust spent): it cries out when anything comes near, waking you, while you camp there; companions cast it as a ritual before a rest; other triggers and messages are left out

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries.note: on the caster's own weapon

entries.name: Major Image
entries.note: in a town: an image with sound and smell draws the eyes away for ten minutes (-10); from a 4th-level slot it stays until you leave the town (the book: until dispelled); in a fight left out

entries.name: Mass Heal
entries.note: 700 hit points shared among the friends within 60 feet, the most hurt first (the book lets the caster divide them as they choose), and blindness, deafness and poison ended on each one healed

entries.name: Mass Suggestion
entries.note: up to twelve foes, nearest first, stand down (incapacitated) until hurt for the day; the 25-word task and the Charmed condition are left out

entries.name: Maze
entries.note: the Study action to escape is a DC 20 Investigation check each of its turns; it returns to the same square, or the nearest free one

entries.name: Meld into Stone
entries.note: a ward for a lone caster: rest hidden however many hunt nearby; in a party it is refused (only the caster fits); the damage of a broken stone is left out

entries.name: Message
entries.note: a companion waiting in the same town hears the whisper and comes at once; use in a fight left out

entries.name: Meteor Swarm
entries.note: four 40-foot spheres up to a mile away, each creature caught once (the first sphere where aimed, the others where they catch the most foes and fewest friends), 20d6 fire and 20d6 bludgeoning, Dexterity save for half; dry ground catches fire; damage to loose objects is left out

entries.name: Mind Blank
entries.note: the protections against divination, scrying, emotion and thought reading wait for Part E

entries.name: Mind Spike
entries.note: knowing where the target is is left out

entries.name: Minor Illusion
entries.note: in a town: a sound or an image draws the eyes away for a minute (-5 to every watcher's Perception: thefts, creeping, the watch's recognising look); in a fight left out (no hiding behind an image yet)

entries.name: Mirage Arcane
entries.note: as Hallucinatory Terrain for 10 days at the camp; changing structures and making the illusion solid are left out

entries.name: Mislead
entries.note: in a fight: Invisible until you attack, deal damage or cast (the double goes on, but moving it and seeing through it are left out); outside one, for the hour, nobody in a town sees what you do until an assault or a murder ends it (Invisibility does the same now)

entries.name: Modify Memory
entries.note: on a person near you (Wisdom save): they forget the last day: the crimes of yours they saw and have not reported (and the casting itself), the grudge each left, a Friends of that day; a report already made stands, older grudges stay; planting false memories is left out

entries.name: Moonbeam
entries.note: moved by its follow-up anywhere within 60 feet; the shapechanger's reversion is left out

entries.name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
entries.note: a watch over the camp for 8 hours: whatever comes in the night wakes the party and the first of them is bitten (4d8 force, a Dexterity save) before the fight; never cast in a fight

entries.name: Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion
entries.note: a door out of the world at the camp for a day: everyone eats and drinks their fill, the night is warm, dry and safe, and the party may rest though enemies hunt nearby; the floor plan and the servants are the game's words only

entries.name: Mordenkainen's Sword
entries.note: a melee spell attack for 4d12 force plus the casting modifier at once, and a bonus action each later turn moves the sword (the spiritual-weapon token, 30 feet in the game's rule for tokens) and strikes again; the caster has one such token at a time

entries.name: Nondetection
entries.note: 8 hours: no foe's divination finds the one touched (a foe's Detect Thoughts senses no mind there); no other foe divines yet (Part G's casters)

entries.name: Nystul's Magic Aura
entries.note: on a carried magic thing for 24 hours (Mask): it shows no aura and looks like nothing much, so robbers who take the best things pass it over; False Aura and the creature's mask are left out

entries.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
entries.note: the 60-foot burst of 10d6 cold is as the book says; freezing a body of water and holding the globe to throw later are left out

entries.name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
entries.note: the enclosed creature cannot roll the sphere and nobody can carry it; Disintegrate on the globe is left out

entries.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
entries.note: charmed and dancing on a failed save (no walking, disadvantage on attacks and Dexterity saves, advantage against it); the save to stop takes the dancer's whole turn each time, not only its action; a success dances in place until the caster's next turn

entries.name: Pass without Trace
entries.note: +10 Stealth for the party for an hour (creeping, slipping away, hiding); leaving no tracks has nothing to fool yet

entries.name: Phantasmal Force
entries.note: the harm comes at the start of the target's turns; studying the phantasm is left out

entries.name: Phantasmal Killer
entries.note: the disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls is left out; a success on the first save leaves the concentration running

entries.name: Phantom Steed
entries.note: a rider travels 13 miles an hour on the map; one steed for each rider makes the whole party quick; in a fight the steed is not on the field, and it does not end when hurt

entries.name: Plane Shift
entries.note: until the planes come, the party steps out of the world and back in: at a city's circle known, or 2d12 miles from any other known town

entries.name: Power Word Fortify
entries.note: 120 temporary hit points divided evenly among up to six friends within 60 feet, those nearest a foe first; a friend with more temporary hit points keeps them and the rest share the remainder

entries.name: Power Word Heal
entries.note: range 60 feet as the book says; all hit points back and charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned and stunned ended; a prone creature stands up at once instead of spending its reaction

entries.name: Power Word Kill
entries.note: range 60 feet; dies at 100 hit points or fewer, otherwise 12d12 psychic

entries.name: Power Word Stun
entries.note: the Stunned creature saves each turn end with Constitution; over 150 hit points it loses its speed until the caster's next turn

entries.name: Prayer of Healing
entries.note: the short rest's benefit and the once-a-day limit are left out

entries.name: Prestidigitation
entries.note: outside a fight: the grime of days comes off the party, and what is eaten in the next hour is warm and tasty (as a cooked meal warms); the other small tricks are words only

entries.name: Prismatic Spray
entries.note: a d8 for each creature in the 60-foot cone picks its ray (an eighth face brings two rays); red, orange, yellow, green and blue: 12d6 fire, acid, lightning, poison or cold, half on a save; indigo: restrained, a Constitution save at the end of each of its turns, three failures turn it to stone for good, three successes free it; violet: blinded until the start of the caster's next turn, then a Wisdom save or it is sent from this plane for good; the DM's choice of plane is left out; friends in the cone are hit too

entries.name: Prismatic Wall
entries.note: a 30-foot block stands for the 90-foot wall or the globe; it stops everyone, friends too, and its seven layers are never crossed (nothing would live through them); foes within 20 feet who see it save with Constitution or are blinded for a minute (friends are spared); the layers' damage, destruction by cold, fire, force, wind and Dispel Magic, and designating who may pass are left out; it cannot be dispelled

entries.name: Produce Flame
entries.note: the bonus-action light and the later Magic action to hurl it are folded into one action: a ranged spell attack, 1d8 fire at 60 feet

entries.name: Programmed Illusion
entries.note: a ward on the camp (jade dust at hand): the night's visitors fall on an illusory camp, the real one is awake and sees them first; it stands while you camp there

entries.name: Project Image
entries.note: your image walks into a known town within 500 miles: you hear its news and read its board as if there; talking through it and moving it about are left out

entries.name: Protection from Energy
entries.note: the type is chosen for the caster: the energy the foes here deal most

entries.name: Protection from Evil and Good
entries.note: only the disadvantage on those creatures' attacks; the ward against charm, fear and possession is left out

entries.name: Protection from Poison
entries.note: the advantage on saves against poison is left out

entries.name: Purify Food and Drink
entries.note: on what the party carries: turned food is fresh again, foul water clean

entries.name: Raise Dead
entries.note: on a fallen companion the party carries (a body is buried after ten days unless Gentle Repose keeps it); a companion standing by calls a fallen leader back at once if they can; the 500+ GP diamond is a fine (or a flawless) diamond; a missing head is not modelled

entries.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
entries.note: an hour on the party: while two or more are linked none of them is surprised (the warning passes at the speed of thought)

entries.name: Regenerate
entries.note: outside a fight (it takes a minute): every hit point and wound mended and lost parts grown back at once, rather than a hit point a turn for an hour

entries.name: Reincarnate
entries.note: the new people is rolled on the book's d10 table (rolled again among this world's peoples when the table's is not one), with new looks; the new body is whole, with every hit point (the book does not say)

entries.name: Remove Curse
entries.note: on a person: every cursed thing they wear or are bound to lets go (the curse stays in the thing, as the book says); curses laid on creatures come with the spells that lay them

entries.name: Resistance
entries.note: the damage type is the kind of harm the foes in the fight deal most (the book lets the caster choose)

entries.name: Resurrection
entries.note: on a body the party carries; while bodies are buried after ten days (longer under Gentle Repose) the century and the 365-day strain do not arise

entries.name: Reverse Gravity
entries.note: creatures in the 50-foot cylinder when it is cast save with Dexterity or fall upward 100 feet (20 under a roof, where they strike the ceiling and take the fall) and hang there until concentration ends, then fall; those who walk in later and objects are left out, and a flier is not lifted

entries.name: Revivify
entries.note: also outside a fight: on a friend who fell in a fight's last minute (a companion with it ready casts it at once) and on a fallen leader, by a companion standing by

entries.name: Rope Trick
entries.note: a space out of the world for an hour at the camp: a short rest though enemies hunt nearby; not a hiding place in a fight

entries.name: Scrying
entries.note: a figure of the world (met, a ruler here, a dragon, a work's beast): the book's knowledge modifiers (+5 heard of, +0 met); connections (a likeness, a possession, a body part) are left out; on a failure where they are goes on the map, on a success not again for a day; a place instead of a creature is left out

entries.name: Searing Smite
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute)

entries.name: See Invisibility
entries.note: the invisible are seen as if visible; seeing into the Ethereal Plane waits for the planes (Expansion 26)

entries.name: Seeming
entries.note: 8 hours on the whole party: a disguise whose quality is the caster's spell save DC; unwilling targets are left out

entries.name: Sending
entries.note: a companion waiting anywhere hears the twenty-five words and sets out to meet you (the walk takes its days); other planes and blocking left out

entries.name: Sequester
entries.note: a carried thing (worth 1 GP or more) hidden from robbers, thieves, the watch and divination for good (nothing in the game ends the spell yet); or a fallen friend's body held out of time (its days stop until raised); a willing living creature's suspended animation and the trigger are left out

entries.name: Shatter
entries.note: a construct's disadvantage and the harm to things are left out

entries.name: Shillelagh
entries.note: the choice of force damage is left out

entries.name: Shining Smite
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute); its light and the end of invisibility are left out

entries.name: Silence
entries.note: it stops spells with spoken words; thunder immunity and deafness are left out

entries.name: Silent Image
entries.note: in a town: an image draws the eyes away for ten minutes (-5 to every watcher's Perception); in a fight left out

entries.name: Sleep
entries.note: adapted: the caster's choice of creatures is 'enemies only' (the battle has no per-creature choice yet)

entries.name: Sleet Storm
entries.note: losing Concentration when knocked prone and dousing exposed flames are left out

entries.name: Slow
entries.note: all foes in the cube are affected (the book: up to six); the loss of Reactions and the 25 percent chance a spell with a Somatic component fails are left out

entries.name: Sorcerous Burst
entries.note: the exploding 8s are left out; the type is the one the target is weakest to

entries.name: Speak with Animals
entries.note: ten minutes: beasts met on the road can be talked past with the Influence check; what they saw in the last day is left to Speak with Plants and Beast Sense

entries.name: Speak with Dead
entries.note: a foe slain in the last fight, while you are still there: its band (gang, cult or tribe) and where it keeps its lair (on the map), who sent it, a work's hidden side; five questions told as one answer; a corpse answers once; the undead and beasts say nothing of use

entries.name: Speak with Plants
entries.note: outdoors: the band that roams near is told and seen first for four hours, food is shown (+5 to forage); difficult terrain in a fight and plant creatures are left out

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.note: a Climb Speed equal to the Speed for an hour (fences, barrels, walls of the field); walking on ceilings is not drawn

entries.name: Spike Growth
entries.note: its camouflage is left out

entries.name: Spirit Guardians
entries.note: adapted: enemies inside start their turn at half speed (not halved for every step taken inside)

entries.name: Starry Wisp
entries.note: the light and the end of invisibility are left out

entries.name: Steel Wind Strike
entries.note: one blow for each foe in reach (up to five), the chosen one first; the teleport to a spot beside a target is left out

entries.name: Stoneskin
entries.note: adapted: the diamond dust is not spent yet (material components: Expansion 3)

entries.name: Storm of Vengeance
entries.note: a 300-foot radius up to a mile away; foes under it save with Constitution or take 2d6 thunder and are deafened; later turns bring acid rain 4d6, six lightning bolts 10d6 (Dexterity save for half), hail 2d6 and then 1d6 cold with difficult, heavily obscured ground; it spares the caster's side, as if cast from afar; the wind that makes ranged weapon attacks impossible is left out

entries.name: Suggestion
entries.note: the foe stands down, incapacitated until hurt (no task is given)

entries.name: Sunbeam
entries.note: 6d8 radiant and blinded until the caster's next turn along a 60-foot line, and a follow-up action sends a new line; the mote of light above the caster is left out

entries.name: Sunburst
entries.note: the Darkness it dispels is left out (the spell does not touch magical darkness)

entries.name: Swift Quiver
entries.note: two weapon attacks when cast and two more with each later bonus action; they use the casting modifier in place of Strength or Dexterity (weapon_attack's rule) and any weapon in reach works, not only a bow or crossbow

entries.name: Synaptic Static
entries.note: 8d6 psychic, Intelligence save for half, friends caught too; the failure takes 1d6 off attack rolls until a save at a turn's end; the same penalty on ability checks and Constitution concentration saves is left out

entries.name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter
entries.note: the save with advantage when hurt is left out

entries.name: Telekinesis
entries.note: creatures only: a Strength save or the foe is thrown 30 feet and restrained until the end of the caster's next turn, with an action each later turn to seize a foe again; lifting it into the air, suspension, and moving objects are left out

entries.name: Telepathy
entries.note: a companion far away is reached at once and sets out to meet you; the link's day of shared senses is left out

entries.name: Teleport
entries.note: to any town known, by the 2024 table: a city visited counts as a permanent circle known, the character's home as very familiar, a town visited as seen casually, one heard of as viewed once; a similar area is the nearest town of the same kind; an object alone and false destinations are left out

entries.name: Teleportation Circle
entries.note: to the circle of any city visited (its sigils learned there); the two sigils learned on gaining the spell, and making a permanent circle, are left out

entries.name: Tenser's Floating Disk
entries.note: 500 pounds more before the caster is laden, for an hour; the disk is not drawn and does not balk at stairs or pits

entries.name: Thaumaturgy
entries.note: Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks in the talk that follows (its minute); the tremors, flames and doors are words only

entries.name: Thunderous Smite
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute)

entries.name: Time Stop
entries.note: 1d4+1 extra turns in a row; it ends when an action or effect of the caster reaches another creature; moving more than 1,000 feet away cannot happen on a battlefield

entries.name: Tongues
entries.note: an hour: words on the road go as if the party shared a tongue with any band

entries.name: Transport via Plants
entries.note: from woodland to the woods by any town visited (a tree seen there); the minute's open way for others is the party stepping through together

entries.name: Tree Stride
entries.note: in a fight: from beside a tree to beside another on the field, then again with a bonus action each turn while it holds (the book: 5 feet of movement); trees of the same kind are not told apart

entries.name: True Resurrection
entries.note: on a body the party carries; making a new body for one whose remains are gone is left out (bodies are buried after ten days)

entries.name: True Seeing
entries.note: truesight to 120 feet for an hour on a willing creature touched, using up mushroom powder

entries.name: Unseen Servant
entries.note: for an hour the camp's chores (fire, shelter, tent, cooking, boiling water, butchering) take half the time; other tasks are left out

entries.name: Wall of Fire
entries.note: a straight wall of 60 feet laid out from the caster's side (not anywhere in 120 feet); the ringed wall and the damage to creatures ending a turn within 10 feet of the hot side are left out; it burns only those inside it

entries.name: Wall of Force
entries.note: laid at a point as a 10-foot ring (a line always starts at the caster); it is drawn on glassy ice and also hides what is behind it; Dispel Magic cannot end it; the dome and its uses outside a fight are left out

entries.name: Wall of Ice
entries.note: a 20-foot block of ice that cannot be broken (the book's dome, globe and panels, its hit points and the sheet of frigid air left behind are left out); those caught save for 10d6 cold, 2d6 more per slot above 6

entries.name: Wall of Stone
entries.note: a 20-foot block of impassable stone on the free squares of the area, gone when concentration ends; it cannot be breached (no AC or hit points), never becomes permanent, and its shape is fixed

entries.name: Wall of Thorns
entries.note: a 60-foot line laid from the caster's side (the book: up to 120 feet away, or a circle); 7d8 piercing as it appears, 7d8 slashing to whoever enters or ends a turn in it, blocks sight, difficult ground (the book's four feet of movement per foot is the ordinary rough-ground cost)

entries.name: Warding Bond
entries.note: the platinum rings are left out; it lasts the fight

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.note: nobody drowns yet: up to ten friends breathing water can walk a lake's bottom on the map (slowly, soaked); under the sea waits for Ships & Sea Monsters (22)

entries.name: Water Walk
entries.note: rivers without wading, lakes and the sea walked over on the map, deep water walked in a fight; acid, mud, snow and lava are not yet such ground; the bonus action to go under is left out

entries.name: Web
entries.note: adapted: the webs do not burn away under fire yet

entries.name: Weird
entries.note: 10d10 psychic, Wisdom save for half, frightened on a failure; a frightened foe takes 5d10 at the end of each of its turns until it saves, which ends the damage; the fear itself lasts as long as the caster concentrates (a success does not lift it); Weird is a warlock and wizard spell in the book

entries.name: Wind Walk
entries.note: on the map only: the party flies ten times a walker's pace over anything, nothing on the ground meets it, and nobody loses the way; in a fight the cloud form and the minute to turn back are left out

entries.name: Wind Wall
entries.note: the wall is a straight 50-foot line from the caster toward the chosen point; its pushing of light things and its stopping of small flyers and gases are left out

entries.name: Wish
entries.note: in a fight it copies any battle spell of level 8 or lower with no components and no stress (its level 9 slot and its action), or gives Instant Health to the caster and up to twenty friends, which brings the stress as the book says (1d10 necrotic a spell level for every spell until a long rest, Strength 3 for 2d4 days, a 33% chance never to cast it again); resting does not shorten the days; Object Creation, Resistance, Spell Immunity, Sudden Learning, Roll Redo and Reshape Reality wait for Part E

entries.name: Word of Recall
entries.note: cast standing in a temple it makes that town the sanctuary; cast anywhere after, it takes the caster and five more there

entries.name: Wrathful Smite
entries.note: the 2024 bonus action taken just after a hit is readied on the weapon before the blow (a bonus action, for the next fitting hit within a minute)

entries.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
entries.note: an aura of 10 feet: Wisdom save or 4d6 psychic (half on a save) on entering or ending a turn there; the prone condition and the 10-foot push on a failed save are left out

entries.name: Zone of Truth
entries.note: on a person near you (Charisma save): for ten minutes they cannot lie: a work they gave you that hides something is shown for what it is, an honest one is known honest, otherwise what they want is told; the sphere and others walking into it are left out
